appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Respiratory Clinic Visits'.
A subtitle reads 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Clinic visits (thousands)' and has gridlines at 130, 140, 150, 160, and 170.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and shows tick marks for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
A single red line connects four data points, one for each year from 2017 to 2020.
The data point for 2017 is positioned at approximately 130 on the y-axis.
The data point for 2018 is positioned at approximately 145 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: The task is to review the respiratory clinic volume dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the end-to-end utilization pattern for the full 2013-2020 monitoring window.
The chart displays the yearly visit pattern from 2017 to 2020.
The three options for routing are: 'Route to continued monitoring for a recent upward shift', 'Route to sustained growth follow-up', and 'Route to decline-response review'.
The dashboard only shows data from 2017 to 2020, not the full 2013-2020 window mentioned in the task definition.
uncertain: The chart does not show data for the years 2013-2016, which are part of the 2013-2020 monitoring window. The decision must be based on the visible data, which only covers the most recent four years.
